newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers higher ahead of Chinese New Year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers higher ahead of Chinese New Year.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were firm with the pre-Chinese Lunar New Year demand seen propping up prices, traders said on Monday.

Independents were quoting bunker 380-cst at $100 and 180-cst at $106 per tonne but majors were quoting $1-$2 per tonne higher. But for supplies between February 6-10, offers were even more expensive with 380-cst at $102-$104, sellers said.
Two majors were heard to have sold out of bunker fuel.
MDO and gas oil prices were quoted unchanged at $198-$200 and $205-$210 respectively.
